selection: 20 additional meetings, prioritizing varied discussion topics and design stages; no participant overlap with the five earlier AMI meetings or between new meetings; metadata selection is deliberate, not a random sample.
stages: generate from all available earlier speech
blind full-history screening without the proposed answer
Codex review of candidates and cited source speech
screening_limit: Generation and screening use the same local checkpoint. Model agreement is not independent validation or a certified multi-hop label.

roles.0: Qwen3 30B Instruct weights and KV cache; stages run sequentially

resources.shared_components: One resident vLLM engine for generation and text screening
resources.dependencies: Prepare and preflight inputs before submission; generation precedes screening; Codex review precedes acceptance; no speech or duplex service
